200.description: The pool as configured, with its live occupancy.

mode.description: ReleaseFed pools are volume-controlled by this service (WIP limit is a hard invariant); FlowFed pools admit on priority only (WIP limit is an alarm threshold, not enforced).
mode.title: PoolMode

wip.description: Released-but-not-completed entries right now. May exceed `wipLimit` after a limit was lowered below it.

400.description: Malformed body, a missing `wipLimit`, a `wipLimit` that is not a positive integer (`invalid-wip-limit`), a `mode` other than `ReleaseFed`/`FlowFed` (`unknown-feed-mode`), or a `pathId` outside the deployment's declared process-path families (`unknown-path-id`).
